self_caught_probe_defect.what: My first focus probe pressed 'escape' to blur between key presses and reported 'g -> find_input' on EVERY screen, which would have been a false finding that action_focus_goto is broken.
self_caught_probe_defect.why: An Input keeps focus through escape, so the 'g' was TYPED INTO the input rather than dispatched as a binding.
self_caught_probe_defect.fix: Revision 2 calls app.set_focus(None) and ASSERTS the blur took effect before each press. Corrected result: g -> cmdbar_goto_input, everywhere - the charter's premise is TRUE.
self_caught_probe_defect.carry: The blur assertion belongs in any Phase-3 keyboard AT. Same class as batch-77's four self-caught lane probes: executing the wrong thing returns a plausible number, which is why it survives review.
self_caught_probe_defect.second_minor: The wrong-pane probe read .renderable off #hex_view and got AttributeError; no conclusion depended on it and none was drawn.
